title: Snake in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Snake body - coiled green -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='28' ry='14' fill='#2ecc40' stroke='#5eea6a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='20' ry='9' fill='#27ae38' />
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='12' ry='5' fill='#2ecc40' />
  
  <!-- Snake body rising up -->
  <path d='M64 66 Q72 56 68 46 Q64 36 54 34 Q46 32 42 38' 
        fill='none' stroke='#2ecc40' stroke-width='11' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 66 Q72 56 68 46 Q64 36 54 34 Q46 32 42 38' 
        fill='none' stroke='#5eea6a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-dasharray='3 8'/>
  
  <!-- Snake head -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='36' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#2ecc40' stroke='#5eea6a' stroke-width='2'/>
  
  <!-- Snake eyes -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='32' r='3.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='32' r='3.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='32' r='2' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='32' r='2' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  
  <!-- Snake smile -->
  <path d='M35 40 Q40 44 46 40' fill='none' stroke='#1a1a2e' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Snake tongue -->
  <path d='M30 38 L24 36 M24 36 L22 33 M24 36 L23 39' fill='none' stroke='#ff4d6d' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Scarf - red -->
  <path d='M32 44 Q38 50 48 46 Q44 42 32 44Z' fill='#ff3333' stroke='#ff6666' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M34 46 Q38 50 46 47' fill='none' stroke='#ff6666' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  
  <!-- Scarf tail hanging down -->
  <path d='M46 46 Q52 52 50 60 Q49 64 46 62 Q48 56 44 50Z' fill='#ff3333' stroke='#ff6666' stroke-width='1'/>
  
  <!-- Scarf stripes -->
  <line x1='43' y1='47' x2='40' y2='51' stroke='#ff9999' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='47' y1='51' x2='46' y2='56' stroke='#ff9999' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  
  <!-- Scarf fringe -->
  <line x1='46' y1='62' x2='44' y2='66' stroke='#ff3333' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='47' y1='62' x2='46' y2='67' stroke='#ff3333' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='48' y1='61' x2='48' y2='66' stroke='#ff3333' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Scarf knot on side -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='46' r='3' fill='#ff5555' stroke='#ff9999' stroke-width='1'/>
</svg>
